sample_size.dry_run_policy: Any optional link/video/endpoint shakedown rows must be excluded from the evidence gate.

prolific_configuration.session2_eligibility: Invite only Session 1 completers using the same PROLIFIC_PID.
prolific_configuration.participant_assignment: The HTML hashes PROLIFIC_PID to one of six sparse forms and uses the same hash in both sessions.
prolific_configuration.response_endpoint: Pass an HTTPS POST endpoint in submit_url or endpoint; URL-encode it if it contains query parameters.

claim_boundary: This setup is not human-memory evidence.
Do not claim actual memorability until delayed Session 2 recognition data clear the pre-registered gate.
Excluded participants and failed-load trials must remain in the exported dataset with explicit exclusion reasons.
